en: Nose, nose, touch your nose! Toes, toes, tap your toes!

zh: 这是什么?这是我的鼻子

en: What can you do? I can run fast.
zh: 你会做什么?我能跑得快

en: What do you do with your hands? I clap and draw.
zh: 你用小手做什么?我拍手和画画

en: Where is your tummy? Here it is!
Can you clap your hands? Yes!
I have two eyes and one nose.
zh: 我有两只眼睛一个鼻子

en: Let me see. Can you walk?
Be careful. Let's put on a band-aid.
I take care of my body.
I brush my teeth every morning.
I wash my hands before dinner.
I jump and run every day.
Apple, apple, yum yum yum! Banana, banana, in my tum-tum-tum!
What's your favorite fruit? I like bananas!
zh: 你喜欢什么水果?我喜欢香蕉

en: What do you want for breakfast? Bread and milk.
zh: 早餐想吃什么?面包和牛奶

en: Would you like some juice? Yes, please!
What's in the bowl? Some soup.
Do you like ice cream? Yes, I love it!
zh: 你喜欢冰淇淋吗?超喜欢

en: I'd like noodles and juice, please.
I have bread, eggs and milk.
At noon, I eat rice, fish and vegetables.
zh: 中午我吃米饭鱼和蔬菜

en: In the afternoon, I eat a sweet apple.
Jump, jump, jump up high! Run, run, run, so fast! Walk, walk, walk and stop! We love to play all day!
Can you jump? Yes, I can!
Do you like to run? Yes!
What can you do? I can swim.
Where is the kite? Up in the sky!
Who is fast? I am fast!
I ride my bike every day.
I got it! I got it!
In the morning, I ride my bike.
At noon, I play ball with Daddy.
I run and jump in the sun.
Dog says woof, cat says meow! Duck says quack, cow says moo! Animals, animals, we love you!
Do you have a pet? Yes, a dog!
What does the cow say? Moo!
Who lives in the water? Fish!
Can a bird fly? Yes, it can!
What color is the cat? Black and white.
Can we go to the zoo?
What a fun day at the zoo!
My cat is white and soft.
Every day, I feed my cat.
My cat is my best friend!
zh: 我的猫是我最好的朋友

en: The hippo is in the pool.
Who lives in water? A whale.
What is in the cage? A parrot.
Can a penguin swim? Yes, it can.
